selection: A head is selected when any of these holds: (a) both arms (openai/gpt-6-astra and a Claude model) reviewed it and reported, and no defect at it labels either arm not-run; (b) a reviewer asserted a decoy at it, rather than raising and withdrawing it in the same report; (c) a defect at it was missed by every arm that reviewed it (found later and measured on this head). A selected head is kept only when a donor shares its bun.lock blob and its crates tree. A decoy refuted only by a deliberate change counts only as an obsolete assertion: a behaviour the author kept on purpose and a reviewer still calls a defect is a disagreement, not a decoy.

excluded.why: no donor shares bun.lock ad3b2401 and crates e7b015bb
